grand_total_note: No grand total is printed, by explicit authorial choice: each campaign is reported by its full grid decomposition, because the axes - not the sum - are what a replication needs. The 'over 15,000 runs' phrasing was removed from the abstract, introduction and conclusion. Do not sum these rows and present the total as a paper figure.
booking_rule: A campaign is listed only where the paper reports its finding. Exploratory runs that were computed but not used are deliberately absent.

footer: All campaigns share the same three-span, physics-consistent cascade R2R simulator and the same ten-plant set drawn from the 204-plant pool. The retuning campaigns use a 6-plant subset and campaign 16 a single plant. The 30 noise-free baseline runs of campaign 5 deterministically reproduce those of campaign 4 bit-for-bit and are retained as an executed wiring-regression gate. Method-internal digital-twin evaluations - the ~2,805-point hierarchical grid search - run on the identified surrogate rather than on the plant and are surrogate evaluations, not plant runs.
